method: Read-only passive 0.5-second sampling during ordinary use; CPU busy from aggregate /proc/stat deltas excluding guest double counting; no synthetic workload.
finding: The largest positive TCMz step followed the largest aggregate CPU busy interval. A roughly 19.8 C negative step occurred about two seconds later as busy fraction returned near idle.
limitations: Short uncontrolled observation, unknown sensor update latency and physical location. Same-sample correlation is weak and not a causal result. scaling_cur_freq is driver-reported rather than an independent effective-frequency measurement. CPU thermal throttling and sensor accuracy remain unqualified. Preserve protections and existing clock ceiling.
